(Currently Amended) 1. A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles having a size greater than 12 micrometers; a thermally conductive binder selected from the group comprising a premixed solder paste; and a solvent wherein the ratio of the cavity-generating particles to the thermally conductive binder is about 1 gram to 0.5-0.8 grams, and the solvent is present in an amount of about 10 ml per gram of particles.

(Currently Amended) 2. The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to a surface of an electronic component.

(Currently Amended) 3. The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the surface of the electronic component.
